title: Vice Salt Nic E-Liquid – Lush Ice 30ml
description:
Description
Introducing Lush Ice by Vice, a refreshing E-liquid that captures the essence of juicy watermelons with a twist of icy coolness. Get ready to be transported to a summer paradise with every puff of this delightful flavor.
With each inhale, you’ll experience the mouthwatering juiciness of ripe watermelons. The authentic taste of this beloved fruit will invigorate your senses, offering a burst of sweetness that is both refreshing and satisfying.
As the vapor unfolds, the coolness of the icy sensation emerges, creating a revitalizing experience that complements the watermelon flavor perfectly. The menthol infusion provides a refreshing twist, adding a crisp and invigorating element to the overall profile.
Vice ensures a smooth and enjoyable throat hit, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the flavorful experience. The blend is carefully crafted using high-quality ingredients, guaranteeing consistency and premium quality with every puff.
Lush Ice by Vice, with its combination of watermelon sweetness and icy coolness, is a must-try for fruit and menthol enthusiasts. Treat yourself to the ultimate summer vape and indulge in the tantalizing fusion of juicy watermelons and refreshing menthol. Let Lush Ice transport you to a state of pure vaping bliss.
Flavour Notes:
Watermelon
Ice
Vice Salt E-Liquid is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Vice E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
50% VG 50% PG
